name: project-context-curator
description: Maintains selectable local or Git-backed canonical context with graph-assisted hybrid retrieval.

thread.condition_shell: test "${PROJECT_CONTEXT_CURATOR_DISABLED:-0}" != "1" && root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)" && case "$common" in */.git) root="${common%/.git}" ;; esac && test ! -e "$root/.no-project-context"
thread.text: Use durable context at the start of each new project-specific topic, not every follow-up. Before making project-specific claims, planning, reviewing, or editing, read docs/context/index.md and search with 1–3 distinctive task terms. Treat results as candidate constraints: use only directly relevant records. If results match only a generic term, conflict, or omit a named concept, inspect the cited canonical context or repository evidence. Project records override domain records, which override universal records. Domain and universal records are not in docs/context views; use search or the cited canonical context.json.

thread.condition_shell: test "${PROJECT_CONTEXT_CURATOR_DISABLED:-0}" != "1" && root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)" && case "$common" in */.git) root="${common%/.git}" ;; esac && test ! -e "$root/.no-project-context"
thread.text: Capture only knowledge expected to outlive the task or branch, benefit unrelated future work, and not be ordinary detail recoverable from code, tests, or docs. Before any add-* write, search existing context and update or consolidate instead of overlapping. Do not record implementation behavior until complete and verified on a long-lived branch; an explicitly user-confirmed decision or invariant may be stored earlier as such. Store admitted knowledge in the same turn. Default to project applicability. Use broader scope only when verified; classify domain only from user confirmation, authoritative domain documentation, or corroborating evidence across registered projects. Use user or machine only for current identity or environment and universal only for context-independent facts. Use move for reclassification. If durability or applicability is uncertain, do not write; ask one concise question.

interface.shortDescription: Capture and retrieve durable project context.
interface.longDescription: Project Context Curator captures and retrieves durable context across named and related projects, migrates it between local and canonical Git storage, and keeps private facts in XDG.
interface.defaultPrompt: Maintain project context while working in this repository.
